dsh-qq2007-skin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. QQ 2007-inspired DSH Web skin: 72 native theme tokens, scoped three-pane chrome, original offline art and pixel buddy, an optional synthesized send chime, responsive/accessibility fallbacks, and reversible Settings switches.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-be891465cb053938ac94.html
